title: Atomic helps bring investing to credit unions
summary: Turnkey digital experiences. Fully customizable front-end experiences that can be tailored to your design system. Developer-friendly APIs.
body_markdown:
> *Watch the interview directly on Bloomberg*[here](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/videos/2024-11-18/atomic-hopes-to-expand-its-crypto-presence-video) ***.***


CEO David Dindi was live on Bloomberg TV to discuss how Atomic can help credit unions easily offer investment services to their members. Atomic recently partnered with One Nevada Credit Union, who will soon offer both automated investing as well as self-directed trading. One Nevada is one of the largest credit unions in Nevada, serving tens of thousands of members. David also discussed the potential impact of regulatory tailwinds on the continuing development of the digital assets space in the U.S.
